assets.description: Top-down view of a village sarpanch candidate's workspace in a fictional north Indian village: a woven charpai under the shade of a neem tree, used as a desk. On it: a red cloth bahi-khata ledger, a folded newspaper (blank, no readable text), a small stack of tied paper files, a glass of chai, an old landline phone, a dented tin cash box and a small spiral notebook. A tear-off wall calendar hangs on a nail in the neem trunk at the top of the frame. A bicycle leans at the edge. Dappled leaf shadows. Leave clear open space in the centre of the charpai for a sheet of paper.
An old cream-coloured rotary landline telephone with a coiled cord, slightly worn and scuffed, seen from directly above to match the desk scene.

The player's personal assistant: a fictional young man in his mid-twenties from a small north Indian village. Sharp, loyal and a little anxious. Neatly combed hair, thin moustache, simple checked half-sleeve shirt with a pen clipped in the pocket.
One villager standing in a rally crowd, seen from behind and slightly above, head and shoulders and upper body. Simple flat shapes suitable for a crowd silhouette; ordinary everyday clothes.
